title: The screws provided will ruin your Roomba!
text: The screws provided will ruin your Roomba!. Bought this mainly for the side brush, filters, and the main brush and beater for our Roomba 690. However, the side brushes are a big problem. The screws they provide do NOT fit. So I didn't think it would matter because I could just use the screw from the original side brush. WRONG! The hole the screw goes into is to small to accommodate the original screw head. In fact, the screws provided in this kit, will strip the holes in the plastic part of the module. So now I guess I have to buy a new side brush module to fix the vacuum. The beater and main brush seemed okay. The filters are cheaper but probably fine. But the side brushes are a fail. So I think I'll return this.
